questions.stem: Where should backup recovery codes be stored?

In a secure password manager or safe

questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: Why length matters more than complexity
questions.stem: What makes a passphrase easier to remember without sacrificing strength?

answer.exemplar: A passphrase of several unrelated common words is memorable as a phrase yet long enough to resist guessing. Randomness of word choice matters more than symbol substitution.

questions.explanation: Multiple unrelated words create length and memorability. Word choice randomness preserves strength.

questions.topic: Features that give a phishing message away

stimulus.body: A message claims to be from a bank and links to 'https://mybank-secure-login.example.com' instead of the bank's real domain.

questions.stem: What is the tell?

options.misconception: length alone is not the issue

options.text: The domain is not the bank's official one

questions.explanation: The domain differs from the official one, revealing impersonation. HTTPS and path segments do not prove legitimacy.
